about:
Battlefield Fabrication operates from Searcy, Arkansas, serving White County and the surrounding Central Arkansas region. The company is a small, family-owned business that describes itself as a licensed and insured contractor specializing in metal-roofed buildings and portable structures. No founding year or founder names are disclosed in public materials.

Its core services span the full build cycle: site preparation and dirt work including clearing and grading; concrete foundations such as slabs and footings; custom construction of barndominiums, pole barns, stud‑wall shops, and portable buildings; and metal roofing installation using standing‑seam or exposed‑fastener systems. The firm also supplies building kits for shops and portable structures, along with hardware, fasteners, luxury vinyl plank flooring, and counter tops. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

Customers include homeowners, agricultural operators, and commercial clients seeking turnkey buildings for residential, farm, or light‑industrial use. Concrete examples from the company’s own descriptions include barndominiums for living space, pole barns for equipment storage, custom shops for workshops, and portable buildings for flexible occupancy. The business focuses on the White County area but notes a broader Central Arkansas reach.

Battlefield Fabrication emphasizes seamless communication from start to finish, affordable pricing on quality metal‑roofed buildings, and a single‑source approach that handles dirt work, concrete, framing, and roofing under one contract. The company also highlights warranties on its metal roofing installations as a differentiator.
